summary: Implemented the progress reading feature in rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _display_reader, public module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods), added 25 tests in tests/test_progress.py, added docs subsections in docs/source/progress.rst, and added a CHANGELOG bullet linking PR 1759. All changes are additions and nothing is committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run per instructions, so verification is by reading only. One known compromise: the module-level open forwards mode through an Any-typed local to satisfy the Progress.open overloads. The return-line type-ignores on the module-level functions may be reported as unused by mypy.
